entries.raw: *A series of suspected U.S. missile strikes causes at least 15 deaths in [[North Waziristan]], [[Pakistan]]. [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia/2010/12/20101228124531710613.html (Al Jazeera)]
entries.text: A series of suspected U.S. missile strikes causes at least 15 deaths in North Waziristan, Pakistan.

entries.raw: *[[Piracy in Somalia|Somali pirates]] release a [[Germany|German]] ship with 22 crew, eight months after it was seized near [[Oman]]. entries.text: Somali pirates release a German ship with 22 crew, eight months after it was seized near Oman.

entries.raw: *The death toll from recent violence between [[Christians]] and [[Muslim]]s in [[Jos]], [[Nigeria]], rises to 80. [[Islam]]ist group [[Boko Haram]] claims responsibility for the deadly [[Christmas Eve]] bombings in the city. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE6BP0PD20101228 (Reuters)] [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-12/28/c_13666730.htm (Xinhua)] [http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/3/15/2778/Business/Region/Youth-unemployment-sparks-Tunisian-tinderbox.aspx (Al Jazeera)]
entries.text: The death toll from recent violence between Christians and Muslims in Jos, Nigeria, rises to 80. Islamist group Boko Haram claims responsibility for the deadly Christmas Eve bombings in the city.

entries.raw: *A late [[Bronze Age]] grave of a Celtic princess has been unearthed in [[Heuneburg]], Germany. Grave goods of Celtic jewellery made of gold, bronze, coal and amber have been discovered. [http://www.spiegel.de/wissenschaft/mensch/a-736863.html (''Der Spiegel'' (de))]
entries.text: A late Bronze Age grave of a Celtic princess has been unearthed in Heuneburg, Germany. Grave goods of Celtic jewellery made of gold, bronze, coal and amber have been discovered.

entries.raw: *[[Israel]]i archaeologists reportedly discover human remains from 400,000 years ago, challenging the theory that [[human]]s originated in [[Africa]]. [http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5jYU4h8Hx0oKxhOJbe8LNQXlBsNNQ?docId=CNG.931a94a2c7ebe97a39cda7089b78517d.2f1 (AFP via Google News)] [http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/article1011760.ece (''The Hindu'')] [http://www.presstv.ir/detail/157621.html (Press TV)]
entries.text: Israeli archaeologists reportedly discover human remains from 400,000 years ago, challenging the theory that humans originated in Africa.

entries.raw: *[[Elton John|Sir Elton John]] and his partner [[David Furnish]] become parents after a [[surrogate mother]] from [[California]] gives birth to a son on [[Christmas Day]]. The boy is named Zachary Jackson Levon Furnish-John. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-12084650 (BBC)]
entries.text: Sir Elton John and his partner David Furnish become parents after a surrogate mother from California gives birth to a son on Christmas Day. The boy is named Zachary Jackson Levon Furnish-John.

entries.raw: *[[2010 Tunisian protests]]: Protests in [[Tunisia]] over unemployment and poor living conditions are criticized by [[List of Presidents of Tunisia|President]] [[Zine El Abidine Ben Ali]] during a national television broadcast; he warns of "firm" punishment. entries.text: 2010 Tunisian protests: Protests in Tunisia over unemployment and poor living conditions are criticized by President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali during a national television broadcast; he warns of "firm" punishment.

entries.raw: *[[Turkey|Turk]]ish construction workers employed in [[Israel]] protest in front of the Turkish Embassy in [[Tel Aviv]] over fears they may lose their jobs. entries.text: Turkish construction workers employed in Israel protest in front of the Turkish Embassy in Tel Aviv over fears they may lose their jobs.

entries.raw: *Thousands of homes and businesses in [[Northern Ireland]] are without water as melting snow and ice from the recent [[Winter of 2010-2011 in Great Britain and Ireland|freezing weather conditions]] reveals burst pipes. [[Northern Ireland Water]] says it is alternating supplies from reservoirs in order to help alleviate the crisis in which some have been without supplies since before Christmas. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-12082535 (BBC)]
entries.text: Thousands of homes and businesses in Northern Ireland are without water as melting snow and ice from the recent freezing weather conditions reveals burst pipes. Northern Ireland Water says it is alternating supplies from reservoirs in order to help alleviate the crisis in which some have been without supplies since before Christmas.

entries.raw: *5 male teenagers from [[Little Haiti (Miami)|Little Haiti]], [[Miami]], in the [[U.S. state]] of [[Florida]] are killed by [[carbon monoxide poisoning]] in a [[motel]] room after fumes from a car kept [[Idle (engine)|idling]] overnight vent up a staircase into their room. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-12087305 (BBC)] [http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jnvIA9yUFr-Na0YaImatIS0Jxjcw (Associated Press via Google News)]
entries.text: 5 male teenagers from Little Haiti, Miami, in the U.S. state of Florida are killed by carbon monoxide poisoning in a motel room after fumes from a car kept idling overnight vent up a staircase into their room.

entries.raw: *A [[Russia]]n [[Antonov An-22|Antonov]] military cargo plane crashes between [[Tula, Russia|Tula]] and [[Oryol]], Russia, killing all 11 on board.[http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5ja176VLUspLCca11CsA4zkJfF-Vw?docId=ef84d32fe41343a18d41f3466c36d2cc (AP via Google)]
entries.text: A Russian Antonov military cargo plane crashes between Tula and Oryol, Russia, killing all 11 on board.

entries.text: A fire in a New Orleans warehouse kills eight people and two dogs, most of them homeless artists and musicians.

entries.text: 33 leading forensic scientists have expressed concerns about the UK Government's plans to close the Forensic Science Service, saying that the justice system will take a "backward step" as a consequence.

entries.text: The UK Government gives the go-ahead to plans to allow popular online petitions to be debated in Parliament within a year.
